Cajun delight in HCMC
Jun 2018 • Friends
This I decided to try something different from Vietnamese or Japanese foods, I went for Cajun Seafoods .. Vua Cua .. King of Crab.
We had the Seafood Combo for 2 persons - 850,000 VND which comprises of ..
1 Canada lobster
2 small size crab
200gr of mussel
200gr of clam
200gr of clam ( different type of clam)
Sweet corn & baby potatoes 
(Both type of clam was not available and was replace with crawfish cooled with Cajun sauces.
The small crabs was good so was the crawfish however the Canada lobster was not so good .. I prefer the tropical lobsters found in the Asian waters.
We also order chicken wings with Cajun sauce, Shrimp roll potatoes and North pole shrimp - cold serving.
Overall the meal was good and I would come back to try the other dishes.

Apart from Cajun, they also have Hotpot with seafood 
The restaurant small but the were 2 floors located at 30 Vu Huy Tan, Phuong 3, Binh Thanh district, HCMC.
Operating hours from 10am till 9pm .. payment can be done with Visa, MasterCard and PayPal.
